knownLimits: No browser navigation, PNG, screenshot inspection, actual font result, compiled CSS hash, contrast measurement or owner adoption has occurred in writer preparation.
The specimen is HTML/CSS, not React or an implementation of the proposed union, normalization, native filtering or events.
The focused/disabled illustrations are inert spans. They do not prove keyboard, focus-visible, disabled semantics, hit-testing, child preservation or accessibility.

Avatar both sides are authored reconstructions; no actual migration exists. Outline approximates the current token-width Tailwind ring without hand-authoring a shadow. True box-shadow/cascade parity requires a later real baseline/runtime comparison.
The Avatar token-stop gradient reconstructs existing source utilities, not a new gradient recipe. There is no photo fixture, decoding/fallback transport or fabricated broken-image result.
Capped count 9999+ illustrates width growth but does not cover MAX_SAFE_INTEGER text or every zoom/host clipping combination.
No production CVA build, packed consumer, runtime test, AT evaluation, native review or actual Controls result is implied.
Existing upstream/historical references are not newly inspected or owner-adopted here. Proposed filenames are requests, not links to existing assets.
